policy: Camada temporal editorial do Macro08 (build_entenda_macro_segment.py). Classes: OPERATIVE_CURRENT, OPERATIVE_TRANSITION, EFFECT_EXHAUSTED, REVOKED (derivado do runtime), HISTORICAL_ONLY, FUTURE_TRIGGER, PARTIALLY_OPERATIVE, EXTERNAL_STATUS_REQUIRED. Toda classificacao traz proveniencia no texto versionado (runtime oficial sha256 7ef82290...) ou nas anotacoes da fonte estrutural canonica; nada de memoria. Data de referencia: 2026-10-05.
